data: Which of the following sets of seeds demonstrates the largest difference between training and test performance in the 'score' subplot?

The question asks for the set of seeds that demonstrates the largest difference between training and test performance in the 'score' subplot. The relevant information is provided in the caption, which states that the figure shows training and test performance when training on restricted sets of seeds. The 'score' subplot is the left graph in the compound figure.

To analyze the relationship between the lines in the 'score' subplot, we need to compare the positions of the train and test lines at each number of training seeds. The larger the gap between these two lines, the larger the difference between training and test performance.

Looking at the graph, the set of seeds labeled as '∞' appears to have the largest gap between the train and test lines. This suggests that this set of seeds demonstrates the largest difference between training and test performance in the 'score' subplot.
